title: Certificates of Deposit: early withdrawal penalty schedule by tier
content:
## Scope

This schedule covers the penalty settings of every Certificates of Deposit tier for principal taken out before maturity: the standard penalty in days of interest, the minimum penalty in the first days after funding, the penalty-free point where a tier offers one, the rate basis used, whether a penalty may reach into principal, and whether the death or incompetence waiver is available.

## Definitions

- **Standard penalty days** are the days of simple interest charged as the penalty on principal withdrawn before maturity.
- **First-six-days minimum penalty days** are the minimum penalty, in days of simple interest, on principal withdrawn within six calendar days after funding, whatever the tier.
- **Penalty-free after** is the number of calendar days after funding after which a full withdrawal carries no penalty, or "not offered" where the tier has no such point.
- **Penalty rate basis** is the rate used in the penalty calculation; every tier lists it as the certificate interest rate.
- **Penalty may reduce principal** states whether a penalty larger than the interest earned is taken from principal.
- **Death or incompetence waiver** states whether the early withdrawal penalty is waived after the owner's death or court-adjudicated incompetence.

## Penalty schedule

| Tier | Standard penalty days | First-six-days minimum penalty days | Penalty-free after (calendar days after funding) | Penalty rate basis | Penalty may reduce principal | Death or incompetence waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 90 | 7 | Not offered | Certificate interest rate | Yes | Yes |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0 | 7 | 6 | Certificate interest rate | Yes | Yes |
| 12-Month Certificate | 90 | 7 | Not offered | Certificate interest rate | Yes | Yes |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 180 | 7 | Not offered | Certificate interest rate | Yes | Yes |
| 36-Month Certificate | 180 | 7 | Not offered | Certificate interest rate | Yes | Yes |
| 60-Month Certificate | 365 | 7 | Not offered | Certificate interest rate | Yes | Yes |

## Tier contrasts

- **Longest standard penalty:** the 60-Month Certificate, at 365 days of interest.
- **Same standard penalty:** the 6-Month and 12-Month Certificates share 90 days; the 18-Month Bump-Up and 36-Month Certificates share 180 days.
- **No standard penalty:** the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate carries 0 standard penalty days and is the only tier with a penalty-free point, at 6 calendar days after funding.
- **Uniform settings:** every tier shares the 7-day first-six-days minimum, the certificate interest rate as penalty rate basis, a penalty that may reduce principal, and the death or incompetence waiver.

## Points of judgement

**Does the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate ever carry a penalty?**
Its standard penalty days are 0, but the first-six-days minimum of 7 days applies on every tier, whatever the tier, to principal withdrawn within six calendar days after funding.

**Can a penalty be larger than the interest the certificate has earned?**
Yes. On every tier the penalty may reduce principal, so a penalty larger than interest earned is taken from principal.

**Is the waiver limited to some tiers?**
No. The death or incompetence waiver is available on all six tiers.
